This integration brings your GROHE Smarthome appliances into Gladys: water leak
detection, water shut-off, pressure and consumption, and the GROHE Blue tap.

## Supported appliances

| Appliance                      | What Gladys shows                                                                     |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GROHE Sense                    | Water leak, temperature, humidity, battery                                            |
| GROHE Sense Guard              | Water valve (open / close), water leak, flow, pressure, water temperature, used today |
| GROHE Blue Home / Professional | Filter remaining, CO2 remaining                                                       |

## Before you start

- Your appliances are set up in the **GROHE Sense** app (also called GROHE ONDUS) and
  work there.
- You know the e-mail and password of that app account.
- Gladys has Internet access: GROHE appliances only talk to the GROHE cloud. There is
  nothing to set up on your local network.

## Setup

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**, find **GROHE Smarthome** and install it.
2. In the **Configuration** screen, enter your **GROHE e-mail** and **GROHE password**,
   then save.
3. Click **Test the connection**: the message lists the appliances found.
4. Open the **Discover** tab and add the appliances you want.

The values show up at the next read of the GROHE cloud (every 5 minutes by default).

### Settings

| Setting              | Default | What it does                                                                                  |
| -------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GROHE e-mail         | —       | The e-mail of the GROHE Sense app.                                                            |
| GROHE password       | —       | Its password. Stored as a secret, only sent to GROHE.                                         |
| Refresh interval (s) | 300     | How often the GROHE cloud is read (60 to 3600). One read covers every appliance.              |
| Detailed logs        | off     | Writes every read in the logs to understand a problem. Passwords and tokens are never logged. |

Below 300 seconds GROHE may slow your account down: keep the default unless you need
faster values.

## The devices

### GROHE Sense

- **Water leak**: 1 when the GROHE app has an unread flood alert for this sensor. It
  goes back to 0 once you read the alert in the GROHE app.
- **Temperature**, **Humidity**, **Battery**.

The Sense runs on batteries and only sends its values a few times a day: its values are
not live. A flood alert is sent at once.

### GROHE Sense Guard

- **Water valve**: a switch. On = open (water flows), off = closed (water shut off).
  You can turn it on and off from Gladys.
- **Water leak**: unread alert for water detected, pipe break or micro-leak.
- **Water flow** (m³/h), **Water pressure** (bar), **Water temperature** (°C, measured
  in the pipe: it does not count in the room temperature), **Water used today** (litres).

### GROHE Blue Home / Professional

- **Filter remaining** and **CO2 remaining**, in percent.
- Tapping water is a scene action (see below).

## Scenes

### Triggers

| Trigger                            | When                                                                           | Filters            |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ |
| **A GROHE water leak is detected** | New alert: flooding, water detected, pipe break or micro-leak                  | Appliance          |
| **A GROHE notification arrives**   | Any new notification of the GROHE app (frost, low battery, unusual use, leak…) | Appliance, level   |
| **A GROHE valve opens or closes**  | A Sense Guard valve moved by itself (leak protection) or from the GROHE app    | Sense Guard, state |

Orders given by Gladys never fire **A GROHE valve opens or closes**.

The notifications already in the GROHE app when the integration starts are not
replayed: only the new ones fire the triggers.

The triggers give these variables to the next actions of the scene:

- `device_name`: the name of the appliance;
- `code`: the GROHE code of the notification (for example `30:0` for flooding);
- `message_en`, `message_fr`, `message_de`, `message_es`: the text of the notification,
  in each language;
- `level` (notification trigger): `info`, `warning` or `alarm`;
- `state` (valve trigger): `open` or `closed`.

### Actions

| Action                          | Fields                                                         | Result       |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| **Open or close a GROHE valve** | Sense Guard, open or close                                     | `valve_open` |
| **Measure the water now**       | Sense Guard                                                    | `requested`  |
| **Tap water from a GROHE Blue** | GROHE Blue, still / medium / sparkling, amount (50 to 2000 ml) | `amount_ml`  |

### Example: shut off the water on a leak

1. Trigger: **A GROHE water leak is detected** (any appliance).
2. Action: **Open or close a GROHE valve** → your Sense Guard → **Close**.
3. Action: send a message, for example "Leak: \{\{triggerEvent.data.message_en\}\}
   (\{\{triggerEvent.data.device_name\}\})".

## Dashboard widget

Add the **GROHE water** widget to a dashboard. It shows:

- whether the GROHE cloud answers, and when it was last read;
- the leaks in progress (in red) and the state of each valve;
- two live tiles: water pressure and water used today (or the temperature and humidity
  of a Sense when you have no Sense Guard);
- the last GROHE notifications (5 by default, 0 to 8 in the widget settings);
- buttons: **Close the water** / **Open the water**, **Refresh**, **Documentation**.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem                                 | What to do                                                                         |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| "GROHE refused the login"               | Check the e-mail and password: sign in to the GROHE Sense app with them.           |
| "The GROHE cloud cannot be reached"     | Check the Internet access of Gladys.                                               |
| "Connected, but no appliance was found" | The appliances must be set up in the GROHE Sense app, on the same account.         |
| "The GROHE cloud asks to slow down"     | Raise the refresh interval (300 seconds or more).                                  |
| A Sense value does not change           | Normal: the Sense only sends its values a few times a day.                         |
| Water leak stays at 1                   | Read the alert in the GROHE app: the leak feature goes back to 0 at the next read. |
| Something else                          | Turn **Detailed logs** on, reproduce, and look at the logs of the integration.     |

## Privacy and security

- The e-mail and password are only sent to the GROHE cloud, over HTTPS.
- The GROHE tokens stay in memory; nothing is written to disk.
- Passwords and tokens never appear in the logs.
- See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-grohesmarthome/blob/HEAD/./SECURITY.md) to report a vulnerability.

This project is not affiliated with GROHE. GROHE publishes no official API: the
integration uses the one of the GROHE Sense app, which GROHE can change at any time.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings GROHE Smarthome asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | Sign in with the account of the GROHE Sense app (GROHE ONDUS): the integration reads your Sense, Sense Guard and Blue from the GROHE cloud. An Internet access is needed. Once the connection works, add your appliances from the Discover tab. |
| GROHE e-mail | `string` | Yes | The e-mail address you sign in to the GROHE Sense app with. |
| GROHE password | `secret` | Yes | The password of that account. It stays in Gladys and is only sent to GROHE. |
| Refresh interval (s) | `number` | No | How often the GROHE cloud is read, in seconds (60 to 3600). One read covers every appliance. Below 300, GROHE may slow the account down. |
| Detailed logs | `boolean` | No | Write every read of the GROHE cloud in the logs, to understand a problem. Passwords and tokens are never written. |

## How to install GROHE Smarthome in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: GROHE Smarthome appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/prohand/gladys-grohesmarthome:1.0.1`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/prohand/gladys-grohesmarthome](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-grohesmarthome).

GROHE Smarthome requires Gladys `>=5.3.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations
